acceptance_criteria.criterion: node scripts/extract-changelog-entry.js runs without error and prints valid JSON to stdout when GITHUB_OUTPUT is not set.
The parsed version matches the topmost ## v* heading in changelog.md.
The parsed title has no trailing date suffix.
The body contains the bullet lines from the topmost entry.
When GITHUB_OUTPUT is set to a temp file path, the script writes version, title, and body outputs in the Actions multiline heredoc format.
Script exits with code 1 if changelog.md is missing or malformed.
No require() calls for external packages (no node_modules dependency).

summary: Created scripts/extract-changelog-entry.js (CJS, no external deps). Reads changelog.md from workspace root, normalises CRLF for cross-platform regex matching, finds topmost ## v* entry, strips optional date suffix from title, collects body bullets. In local mode prints JSON to stdout; when GITHUB_OUTPUT is set writes version/title/body in heredoc format. Handles missing file and malformed changelog with exit code 1. All 7 AC verified locally including GITHUB_OUTPUT mode via temp file.

All 7 acceptance criteria verified: local JSON output correct (version v1.6.0, title without date suffix, body with all bullet lines), GITHUB_OUTPUT heredoc format confirmed via temp file, exit code 1 on missing/malformed changelog, no external require() calls.

Code review passed. Script follows CJS 'use strict' style consistent with other scripts/. CRLF normalisation is correct. Regex handles both - and em-dash separators. Heredoc delimiter EOF_BODY is safe (non-colliding). Error paths exit with code 1. No external dependencies.
No additional documentation required. Script has inline JSDoc comments describing inputs, outputs, and exit codes. All 7 AC met.
